title: Neon Courier — One-Button Rooftop Heist

checks.name: Offline package and gameplay feature verification
checks.details: Parsed the inline JavaScript, rejected remote runtime references, checked the README structure, and verified 14 required gameplay, input, accessibility, persistence, collision, procedural-generation, and bounded-entity feature groups.

checks.name: Seven-second direct-open Chrome attract-mode smoke test
checks.details: Opened index.html directly from disk at 1600×900, advanced attract mode for seven virtual seconds, produced a complete screenshot with title, objective, courier, rooftops, hazards, skyline, rain, and HUD visible, and found no uncaught JavaScript or page-console errors in the Chrome log.

summary: A polished dependency-free Canvas 2D endless rooftop runner with a representative automated attract run, one-button charged jumps and air dashes, deterministic procedural rooftops, fair swept collisions, near misses, escalating difficulty, local best-score persistence, accessibility support, and a neon graphic-novel city presentation.
